hooks.name: schema-contract-sync
hooks.description: When agent/schemas.py changes, keep the frontend types and API docs in sync with the Pydantic contract.

action.prompt: agent/schemas.py just changed. With minimal edits: (1) update frontend/src/types/api.ts so every Pydantic model used in API responses has a matching TypeScript type; (2) check agent/app.py routes still use the right models; (3) if ClashReport/Verdict/Memo changed, update data/demo_cache files' shape or tell me which ones are now invalid. Do not change behaviour. Report the files touched in one line.
